Template for element_query, defuse_query, and extract_inheritance implementation
Minimal language handler template (no defuse_query, no handlers)

conventions.commits: Conventional commits with signed DCO (Signed-off-by footer); examples: 'chore(deps): update', 'feat(bench):', 'fix(ci):'
conventions.testing: Unit tests colocated in language modules with #[cfg(test)] blocks; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/; test patterns use tree-sitter Parser and QueryCursor to verify query correctness
conventions.linting: Clippy with deny-level workspace lints: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (with test exemptions); cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; ParserError enum used for UnsupportedLanguage, QueryError, and semantic extraction failures; no unwrap/expect in production code

patterns: Each language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY constants as &str
Optional query constants: REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, IMPL_QUERY, IMPL_TRAIT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY
Optional handler functions: extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance
Language registration in mod.rs get_language_info() match arm returns LanguageInfo struct with all fields
Extension map in lang.rs maps file extensions (lowercase) to language identifiers
Tree-sitter grammar crate added to workspace.dependencies in Cargo.toml with pinned version
CSS language is minimal: only ELEMENT_QUERY and IMPORT_QUERY, no defuse_query, no handlers
Java language is comprehensive: all query types, all handler functions, extract_inheritance walks base_clause and interfaces fields
constraints: PHP must support functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, and enums as declaration kinds
Tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 is the current stable version with full PHP 8.3 support
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic analysis (def-use sites for variable tracking)
Extract_inheritance must walk base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) fields
All queries must compile and match against tree-sitter-php grammar node types
test_coverage: Existing language modules have unit tests for: query compilation and matching (ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY), handler function correctness (extract_function_name, extract_inheritance), and edge cases (empty files, malformed syntax). Integration tests in acceptance_tests.rs verify end-to-end analysis. New PHP support must include tests for all declaration kinds and inheritance patterns.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP constant; Rust crate bindings at https://docs.rs/tree-sitter-php/latest/
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar supports function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, anonymous_class, anonymous_function, arrow_function. Inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements). Imports via use_declaration and namespace_use_declaration. Variables via variable_name, assignment_expression, augmented_assignment_expression, static_variable_declaration. Function calls via function_call_expression and member_call_expression.

library_findings.relevant_api: Query::new(), QueryCursor, Node field access via child_by_field_name()
library_findings.notes: Workspace dependency pinned in Cargo.toml. Used by all language modules to compile and execute tree-sitter queries.

approaches.name: Comprehensive PHP handler with all features
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, anonymous_class, and anonymous_function. Include CALL_QUERY for function_call_expression and member_call_expression. Add REFERENCE_QUERY for type references. Add IMPORT_QUERY for use_declaration and namespace_use_declaration. Add DEFUSE_QUERY for variable writes (assignment_expression, augmented_assignment_expression, static_variable_declaration) and reads. Implement extract_inheritance handler to walk base_clause and class_interface_clause. Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language(). Add 'php' to lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP for '.php' extension. Add tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 to Cargo.toml workspace.dependencies. Add pub mod php to mod.rs. Include comprehensive unit tests.
pros: Matches existing language handler architecture exactly
Enables full semantic analysis: functions, classes, inheritance, imports, def-use tracking
Supports all PHP declaration kinds including modern features (traits, enums, anonymous classes)
cons: Requires crafting correct DEFUSE_QUERY for PHP variable semantics
Larger implementation (~350-400 lines) than minimal approach

approaches.name: Minimal PHP handler (CSS-like)
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY. No DEFUSE_QUERY, no REFERENCE_QUERY, no IMPORT_QUERY. No handler functions (all None). Register in mod.rs with minimal LanguageInfo. Add to lang.rs and Cargo.toml. This follows the CSS pattern: basic declaration extraction without semantic analysis.
cons: Inconsistent with most other language handlers (Java, Python, Kotlin all have DEFUSE_QUERY)

approaches.name: Phased approach: start minimal, add features incrementally
approaches.description: Phase 1: Implement minimal handler (approach 2) with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only. Phase 2 (follow-up PR): Add REFERENCE_QUERY and IMPORT_QUERY. Phase 3 (follow-up PR): Add DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance handler. This allows landing PHP support quickly while deferring complex semantic features.
pros: Reduces risk of single large PR
Easier code review in smaller chunks
cons: Inconsistent feature set during intermediate phases

recommendation: Approach 1 (Comprehensive PHP handler). The issue explicitly asks to 'add PHP language support' and references Java as the template. Java has DEFUSE_QUERY and extract_inheritance; PHP should match that completeness. The codebase shows that most mature language handlers (Java, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, Go, C++, C#, Swift) include DEFUSE_QUERY and inheritance extraction. CSS and Markdown are exceptions (minimal languages). PHP is a full-featured OOP language like Java, so it warrants the full feature set. The implementation is medium complexity but well-precedented by existing handlers. This ensures PHP support is production-ready on day one.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
(
  (function_definition name: (name) @func_name) @function
  (method_declaration name: (name) @method_name) @function
  (class_declaration name: (name) @class_name) @class
  (interface_declaration name: (name) @interface_name) @class
  (trait_declaration name: (name) @trait_name) @class
  (enum_declaration name: (name) @enum_name) @class
  (anonymous_class) @class
)
inheritance_walk_citation: For class_declaration: walk to child_by_field_name('name') to get class name (type: name). Walk children to find base_clause child (type: base_clause); iterate its named_children to extract each name/qualified_name/relative_name child as 'extends X'. Walk children to find class_interface_clause child (type: class_interface_clause); iterate its named_children to extract each name/qualified_name/relative_name child as 'implements Y'. For interface_declaration: walk to base_clause child and extract each name/qualified_name/relative_name as 'extends Z'. For enum_declaration: walk to class_interface_clause child and extract each name/qualified_name/relative_name as 'implements W'. Source: /tmp/tree-sitter-php/php/src/node-types.json fields for class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration.
